title: FinRL provides an active framework for financial reinforcement learning
friendlyTitle: FinRL is a toolkit for learning about AI trading agents
summary: FinRL is an MIT-licensed framework and collection of examples for applying deep reinforcement learning to financial markets. The long-running project has roughly 16,500 GitHub stars and received code and documentation updates this week.
friendlySummary: FinRL provides code and examples for testing reinforcement-learning methods on financial-market data. The project has about 16,500 GitHub stars and remains active.
whyItMatters: Researchers can use FinRL to reproduce experiments, compare trading-agent approaches and learn the mechanics of financial reinforcement learning. It is an academic toolkit, not financial advice, and live-money use requires rigorous out-of-sample testing and risk controls.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is useful for research and learning. Do not treat an experiment as a safe trading strategy without strong testing and risk limits.
